=== prepare.sbatch
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=qrnamap-prepare
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --output=<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%j.out
#
# Generated by `qrnamap run --slurm`. Builds the reference files and the index once in the run directory, and removes the old outputs of all samples.
# The --cpus-per-task, --mem and --time defaults are UNMEASURED placeholders. Set them from a measured run
# with --cpus, --mem-gb and --time. The --time default is a placeholder. Measured AMB rates with
# --threads 1 (validation/amb/README.md): quant 22.7 to 26.8 s and align 35.2 to 52.1 s per million read pairs.
# The quant rates were measured with kallisto.
# The --mem default is small: AMB data used about 40 MiB (41,208 KB) resident (not measured for large genomes).
# Sample names and FASTQ paths are not in this script: qrnamap reads the sample sheet.
# The tool directories below were found when the scripts were written (ruling R28), so the
# jobs do not depend on the PATH of the shell that runs submit.sh.
set -euo pipefail
export PATH='<D>/tools':"$PATH"
: "${SCRATCH:?SCRATCH is not set: this job needs node-local scratch. Submit from a login shell where \$SCRATCH is set, or regenerate the scripts with --tmpdir DIR.}"
missing=""
for tool in 'kallisto'; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing $tool"
done
if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
  echo "qrnamap: required tools not found on PATH:$missing" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd -- '<CRATE>'
exec '<BIN>' 'run' '--samples' '<D>/sheet.tsv' '--reference' '<CRATE>/../../tests/fixtures/mini/genome.fa' '--gff' '<CRATE>/../../tests/fixtures/mini/genes.gff3' '--mode' 'quant' '--out' '<D>/run' '--strandedness' 'unstranded' '--threads' '1' '--quantifier' 'kallisto' '--max-intron' '5000' '--reads-per-sample' '20000000' '--step' 'prepare' --tmpdir "${SCRATCH:?}"
=== samples.sbatch
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=qrnamap-samples
#SBATCH --array=0-3
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --output=<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%A_%a.out
#
# Generated by `qrnamap run --slurm`. Array task i processes samples [i*1, (i+1)*1) of the sample sheet, in sheet order.
# The --cpus-per-task, --mem and --time defaults are UNMEASURED placeholders. Set them from a measured run
# with --cpus, --mem-gb and --time. The --time default is a placeholder. Measured AMB rates with
# --threads 1 (validation/amb/README.md): quant 22.7 to 26.8 s and align 35.2 to 52.1 s per million read pairs.
# The quant rates were measured with kallisto.
# The --mem default is small: AMB data used about 40 MiB (41,208 KB) resident (not measured for large genomes).
# Sample names and FASTQ paths are not in this script: qrnamap reads the sample sheet.
# The tool directories below were found when the scripts were written (ruling R28), so the
# jobs do not depend on the PATH of the shell that runs submit.sh.
set -euo pipefail
export PATH='<D>/tools':"$PATH"
: "${SCRATCH:?SCRATCH is not set: this job needs node-local scratch. Submit from a login shell where \$SCRATCH is set, or regenerate the scripts with --tmpdir DIR.}"
: "${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID:?this script runs as a SLURM array task}"
cd -- '<CRATE>'
exec '<BIN>' 'quant' '--samples' '<D>/sheet.tsv' '--reference' '<CRATE>/../../tests/fixtures/mini/genome.fa' '--gff' '<CRATE>/../../tests/fixtures/mini/genes.gff3' '--transcripts' '<D>/run/transcripts.fa.zst' '--tx2gene' '<D>/run/tx2gene.tsv.zst' '--out' '<D>/run' '--strandedness' 'unstranded' '--threads' '1' '--quantifier' 'kallisto' '--task-id' "$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID" '--samples-per-task' '1' --tmpdir "${SCRATCH:?}"
=== final.sbatch
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=qrnamap-final
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --output=<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%j.out
#
# Generated by `qrnamap run --slurm`. Gene matrix, then DESeq2 when a contrast was given.
# The --cpus-per-task, --mem and --time defaults are UNMEASURED placeholders. Set them from a measured run
# with --cpus, --mem-gb and --time. The --time default is a placeholder. Measured AMB rates with
# --threads 1 (validation/amb/README.md): quant 22.7 to 26.8 s and align 35.2 to 52.1 s per million read pairs.
# The quant rates were measured with kallisto.
# The --mem default is small: AMB data used about 40 MiB (41,208 KB) resident (not measured for large genomes).
# Sample names and FASTQ paths are not in this script: qrnamap reads the sample sheet.
# The tool directories below were found when the scripts were written (ruling R28), so the
# jobs do not depend on the PATH of the shell that runs submit.sh.
set -euo pipefail
export PATH='<D>/tools':"$PATH"
: "${SCRATCH:?SCRATCH is not set: this job needs node-local scratch. Submit from a login shell where \$SCRATCH is set, or regenerate the scripts with --tmpdir DIR.}"
cd -- '<CRATE>'
exec '<BIN>' 'run' '--samples' '<D>/sheet.tsv' '--reference' '<CRATE>/../../tests/fixtures/mini/genome.fa' '--gff' '<CRATE>/../../tests/fixtures/mini/genes.gff3' '--mode' 'quant' '--out' '<D>/run' '--strandedness' 'unstranded' '--threads' '1' '--quantifier' 'kallisto' '--max-intron' '5000' '--reads-per-sample' '20000000' '--step' 'final' --tmpdir "${SCRATCH:?}"
=== submit.sh
#!/bin/bash
# Generated by `qrnamap run --slurm`. Submits three jobs with sbatch:
#   prepare: reference files and index, once; removes old outputs of all samples
#   samples: array of 4 task(s), 1 sample(s) per task; starts after prepare succeeds
#   final:   gene matrix (and DESeq2 when a contrast was given); starts after every task succeeds
# All paths are written in by qrnamap. This script does not look up its own location.
# The samples and final jobs use --kill-on-invalid-dep=yes: when a job they depend on fails,
# SLURM cancels them instead of leaving them pending.
#
# Recovery when some array tasks fail (the final job is then cancelled, or still pending):
#   1. If the final job is still pending, cancel it (its id is printed by this script):
#        scancel FINAL_JOB_ID
#   2. Fix the cause, then run only the failed task ids again (TASK_IDS such as 3,5):
#        sbatch --array=TASK_IDS --output='<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%A_%a.out' '<D>/run/slurm/samples.sbatch'
#   3. Submit the final job again, after the new array job (NEW_ARRAY_JOB_ID) succeeds:
#        sbatch --kill-on-invalid-dep=yes --dependency=afterok:NEW_ARRAY_JOB_ID --output='<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%j.out' '<D>/run/slurm/final.sbatch'
set -euo pipefail
prepare_id=$(sbatch --parsable --output='<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%j.out' '<D>/run/slurm/prepare.sbatch')
prepare_id=${prepare_id%%;*}
samples_id=$(sbatch --parsable --kill-on-invalid-dep=yes --dependency=afterok:"$prepare_id" --output='<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%A_%a.out' '<D>/run/slurm/samples.sbatch')
samples_id=${samples_id%%;*}
final_id=$(sbatch --parsable --kill-on-invalid-dep=yes --dependency=afterok:"$samples_id" --output='<D>/run/slurm/logs/%x_%j.out' '<D>/run/slurm/final.sbatch')
final_id=${final_id%%;*}
echo "prepare job: $prepare_id"
echo "samples array job: $samples_id (4 task(s))"
echo "final job: $final_id"
echo "logs: "'<D>/run/slurm/logs'
